name: hivemind-capture
description: Capture Codex decisions into HiveMind through the deterministic local CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex decisions with actor provenance.
interface.longDescription: Installs the hivemind-capture skill and MCP server. The skill teaches Codex when to preserve a durable organizational decision, how to say what it rests on, what it binds and what undoing it would cost (a choice that binds nothing and is cheap to undo is not a decision, and a request goes to your tracker), and how to call the HiveMind decision.capture CLI against either a local or shared ledger.
defaultPrompt: Use $hivemind-capture to record this decision, what it rests on, what it binds and what undoing it costs.
Capture the selected option in HiveMind.
Query HiveMind for recent agent captures.
